cat > /tmp/check.py <<'EOF'
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, cv2, sys
a=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[1]); b=pd.read_csv(sys.argv[2]); img=cv2.imread(sys.argv[3]); H,W=img.shape[:2]
def m(r):
    xs=list(map(int,str(r.coords_x).split(','))); ys=list(map(int,str(r.coords_y).split(',')))
    z=np.zeros((H,W),np.uint8); cv2.fillPoly(z,[np.array(list(zip(xs,ys)),np.int32)],1); return z,xs,ys
acc=np.zeros((H,W),int); vis=img.copy()
try:
    from shapely.geometry import Polygon; sh=True
except: sh=False
polys=[]
for i in range(len(b)):
    mb,xs,ys=m(b.iloc[i]); ma,_,_=m(a.iloc[i]); acc+=mb
    n,_=cv2.connectedComponents(mb)
    iou=(mb&ma).sum()/max((mb|ma).sum(),1)
    rect = len(set(zip(xs,ys)))<=4
    print(i,a.type[i],'area',mb.sum(),'iou_orig %.2f'%iou,'cc',n-1,'rect',rect, 'bbox_ok', (min(xs),max(xs),min(ys),max(ys))==(b.xmin[i],b.xmax[i],b.ymin[i],b.ymax[i]))
    cv2.polylines(vis,[np.array(list(zip(xs,ys)),np.int32)],True,(0,255,0),1)
    if sh: polys.append(Polygon(list(zip(xs,ys))))
print('pixel overlap max', acc.max())
if sh:
    print('invalid', sum(not p.is_valid for p in polys))
    print('geom overlaps', sum(polys[i].intersects(polys[j]) for i in range(len(polys)) for j in range(i+1,len(polys))))
cv2.imwrite('/tmp/vis.png',cv2.resize(vis,None,fx=2,fy=2,interpolation=cv2.INTER_NEAREST))
EOF
python /tmp/check.py demo_metadata.csv /tmp/out/result.csv demo_rgb.png
